ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Weeping Stones
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
WEEPINGSTONES_RM_MOD_BUILD_1 Phase A (biome_mod_architecture.md §5) — this mod now carries `RM_WeepingStones`, the franchise-free BiomeDef itself, as its own standalone RimMandrake mod. The campaign twin `RUT_WeepingStones` (src/RimUtinni/ UtinniPatches/Defs/BiomeDefs/RUT_WeepingStones.xml) is FROZEN and keeps carrying the live Ash'karr world until the terminal paint (BIOME_PAINT_ONCE_AT_THE_END_1) — this mod's own copy is not yet on any live tile, which is the expected mid-migration state, not a defect.
The BiomeDef ships with its franchise-free content only: `ColossusToad` (vanilla Odyssey), `AA_Eyeling` (Alpha Animals, non-Star-Wars donor), the 8 wave-2 invented natives (RM_Sillik/RM_Mirrik/RM_Ssurr/RM_Kirruk/RM_Tirbak/RM_Burrak/RM_Vhakk/RM_Vellak) and the canyon-filling crab (RM_Gorrask) in `wildAnimals`; `Plant_Reeds`, `RM_Shadefern` (RULED replacement for the donor `AB_GreenRockFern`), `RUT_Dewshrooms` (shared with The Rot's kit, inline via `mandrake.rut.rotsporekit`), `Plant_Ambrosia` and the 9 other wave-2 invented flora rows in `wildPlants`; the fish bestiary (`RM_Ikkal`/`RM_Tarrik`/`RM_Duul`/`RM_Ullo`/`RM_Ozhu`/`RM_Vobbal`/`RM_SeepStone`, each a duplicate of the frozen twin's own `RUT_` items so both keep resolving independently); its own `RM_BiomeWorker_WeepingStones` in place of the donor `VanillaBiomes.BiomeWorker_ DesertOasis` (a donor type in `workerClass` is a hard dependency the RimMandrake tier may not assume); and the water-truce `modExtensions` block (`RM_WaterTruceExtension`, radius 10, `mandrake.rm.environmentalhazards`) carried over from the twin. `generatesNaturally` is false — this biome is placed by hand (Oasis landmark authoring), never natural worldgen, so its `workerClass` exists to satisfy the field rather than to compete on the tile-scoring pass.
The 8 Star Wars donor fauna the twin's own `wildAnimals` carried inline (`mlie. starwarsanimalcollection`'s Ollopom/Fanback/Dewback/Boma/Dactillion/Bantha/Eopie/Jamel) do NOT ride this def — they ride a Utinni patch instead (`src/RimUtinni/UtinniPatches/Patches/WildAnimals_WeepingStones.xml`, cast as their existing `RSW_` ports), per Q11 (`SW_FAUNA_NEVER_IN_RM_TIER_1`): Star Wars content stays in the campaign tier, never the RimMandrake one.
✅ **Shipped, WEEPINGSTONES_RM_MOD_BUILD_1 wave 2 (2026-09-24)**: the 8 invented fauna and 10 invented flora ruled at `WEEPING_STONES_DESIGN_SITTING_1`, plus the canyon-filling crab ruled at `NIGHTSIDE_ICE_DESIGN_SITTING_1` the same day, all now have ThingDef+PawnKindDef (or PlantDef) pairs — `Defs/ThingDefs_Races/RM_WeepingStonesNatives.xml` (RM_Sillik, RM_Mirrik, RM_Ssurr, RM_Kirruk, RM_Tirbak, RM_Burrak, RM_Vhakk, RM_Vellak), `Defs/ThingDefs_Races/RM_Gorrask.xml` (the canyon crab, adapted from AA_SummitCrab's stats only — no donor dependency; v1 ships as a real single-tile legendary-rare creature, true multi-tile landform occupation is a follow-on mechanic, not built here), and `Defs/ThingDefs_Plants/RM_WeepingStonesNativeFlora.xml` (RM_Dewblade/RM_Weepmat/ RM_Verdimoss/RM_Shadefern/RM_Bladderquill/RM_Salvecomb/RM_Rockfinger/RM_Dripfringe/ RM_Steamfrond/RM_Dewgourd, with three harvested items in `Defs/ThingDefs_Items/RM_WeepingStonesNativeFlora_Items.xml`) — all wired into the BiomeDef's `wildAnimals`/`wildPlants` below. `RM_Shadefern` now REPLACES `AB_GreenRockFern` in `wildPlants` per that sitting's ruling 3; the donor no longer ships wired to this mod. Placeholder art throughout (vanilla-body retints); real art queued this wave. Behavior-comp wiring the roster flagged as optional v1 extras (shade-grid placement reads, the verminbreeder swarm-cycle reuse for mirrik, the tame-soothe-aura reuse for ssurr) is NOT built this pass — every row's mechanism load was ruled "none blocking" for v1, so this is a flagged follow-on, not a silent drop. A live-load proof on Desktop is still owed (offline-only pass per task scope), same as wave 1.
Original description, kept below for the STOCKED_POOL_BUILD_1 content this mod already carries (the Stocked Pool bestiary/cuisine, unwired to any BiomeDef's live spawn lists until the husbandry loop lands — see that build's own wave note):
STOCKED_POOL_BUILD_1 (owner typed 2026-09-24, on `WEEPING_STONES_FISH_HUSBANDRY_1`: "love it. Moisture farmers specializing in fish. Ripe possibilities for rimcuisine stuff too. Make the fish nasty and way too active. And some shouldn't be fish but alien beasts you really wonder if we should be eating.")
This mod is the Weeping Stones' STOCKED line, in the RM_ (RimMandrake) tier: franchise-free, invented names only (Q11a), rich enough to stand alone with no Star Wars dependency. It is distinct from the WILD catch (the ruled gentle six wild fish, unchanged) — nastiness is what domestication and crowding do; the pen makes the monster, never the shore.
The bestiary: `RM_Murrin` (the gentle baseline), four "nasty and way too active" fish (`RM_Skarrin` the ring-breaker jumper, `RM_Karrek` the swarm-flenser, `RM_Vizhik` the traveling pot-eel, `RM_Vhorrin` the mismanagement state made flesh), and three catches that are not fish at all (`RM_Loomu` the caller, `RM_Huldu` the warm one, `RM_Ivvol` the tally) — the best eating in the biome, and nobody eats them comfortably.
Cuisine hooks: six recipes/ingredients including a real doubt-meat mood economy — per-beast "Ate X" thoughts (loomu/huldu/ivvol), graded by callousness/psychopathy, diluted in mixed meals, undiluted in the named roast.
**Build state (2026-09-24, wave 1):** the bestiary (pawn race + PawnKindDef pairs) and the cuisine layer (meat items, recipes, doubt-meat ThoughtDefs) shipped this wave, inert — no spawn path yet.
**Build state (2026-09-24, wave 2):** six of the eight bestiary rows (`RM_Skarrin`/`RM_Karrek`/`RM_Vizhik`/`RM_Loomu`/`RM_Huldu`/`RM_Ivvol`) are now wired into `RM_WeepingStones`'s own `wildAnimals`/`fishTypes` per the two-def law (`RM_Murrin` stays untouched, owed to `FISH_BY_BIOME_1`'s successor; `RM_Vhorrin` stays at zero ambient commonality by design). The pen half of the husbandry loop landed too: a `RM_Zone_PoolPen` zone designator (water cells only, registered on the vanilla "Zone" tab) and `RM_MapComponent_PoolStock` — the per-pool-body bookkeeping the item calls "the honest hard part", pattern stolen from `RM_LiquidBody`/`RM_LiquidStock` (FlowWorks): a sticky body per pen, scribed, computing a Healthy/Thin/Silent/ Vhorrin READ state from a live census of pool fauna standing in the pen. STILL OWED: the STOCK/FEED/HARVEST/OVERDRAW/CULL/RECAPTURE jobs (nothing yet places or moves fauna into a pen — population reads whatever is already standing there), the vhorrin emergence trigger (a live one is correctly detected; nothing spawns one), ring-density overlay art (the gauge is exposed via the zone's inspect string instead), handler injuries, and the vizhik escape event.
**Mod Settings** (MOD_OPTIONS_RETROFIT_1 doctrine): a master "Stocked pools enabled" toggle gates the pen-zone designator and PoolStock's tick logic. Stays OFF by default this wave too — the toggle now gates a real mechanism, but one nothing can populate yet (no STOCK job), so surfacing it by default would hand a player a zone that tracks a population it has no way to fill. Flip to true once the job set lands and a pen is playable end to end. Wild fishing (the ruled gentle six) and the bestiary/cuisine content itself are never touched by this setting.
